text: TINAL DIAGNOSIS: TERMINAL ILEUM AND RIGHT COLON, RIGHT HEMI-COLECTOMY -. A. INVASIVE MODERATELY DIFFERENTIATED ADENOCARCINOMA (5,5 CM) OF CECUM. B. ADENOCARCINOMA INVADES THROUGH MUSCULARIS PROPRIA TO SUBSEROSAL ADIPOSE TISSUE. C. PROXIMAL, DISTAL, AND RADIAL MARGINS FREE OF CARCINOMA. D. NO ANGIOLYMPHATIC INVASION PRESENT. E. HISTOLOGIC GRADE: Low-grade (well to moderately differentiated). PATHOLOGIC STAGING (pTNM): pT3a/b. pNO. Number of nodes examined: 25. Number of nodes involved: 0. pMX. MARGINS: Proximal margin uninvolved by invasive carcinoma. Distal margin uninvolved by invasive carcinoma. Circumferential (radial) margin - Not applicable. Mesenteric margin uninvolved by invasive carcinoma. ANGIOLYMPHATIC INVASION: Absent. PERINEURAL INVASION: Absent. TUMOR BORDER CONFIGURATION: Infiltrating. TUMORAL LYMPHOCYTIC RESPONSE: Mild to moderate.
